Notify.TrueFormSet: Current look recorded as your true form.
Notify.RevertedOnDeath: {name} died and reverted to their true form.
Notify.BadType: Unsupported file type (use PNG, JPG, WEBP, AVIF, GIF, WEBM or MP4).
Notify.NoGM: No GM is connected to receive the upload. Ask the GM to join or to grant you upload permission.
Notify.UploadTimeout: The GM did not answer the upload in time. Try again.
Notify.CorsBlocked: The website blocked downloading that image. Save it to your computer and drag the file in.
Notify.HoverAToken: Hover a token to memorize its face.
Notify.CaptureModeOn: Capture mode: click any token to memorize its face. Esc to exit.
Notify.NotDesignated: The GM has not made this character a changeling.
Notify.Busy: The GM is still receiving your other uploads. Wait for them to finish and try again.
Notify.RateLimited: Too many uploads in a short time. Wait a few minutes.

Dialog.NameLabel: What do you call this face?
Dialog.UseName: Also change the token name to this name
Dialog.DeleteConfirm: Forget the face {name}? (The uploaded image stays on the server.)

HUD.ButtonHint:
Click: change face
Right-click: open the face library
HUD.UploadHint: Choose a file — or drop an image here / paste with Ctrl+V
HUD.CaptureHint: Capture mode: click tokens on the map to memorize their faces (Alt+X)
HUD.Empty: You don't know any faces yet. Hover a token and press Alt+C, use the eyedropper, or upload an image.

Library.Title: Thousand Faces — {name}
Library.SetTrueForm: Use current look as true form
Library.SetTrueFormHint: Records the token's current art/name as your true form (useful if you changed your character art).
Library.DropTitle: Drop images here, paste with Ctrl+V or click to choose
Library.DropHint: Images are downscaled and uploaded to the game server — you don't need to be the host.
Library.RulesReminder: Shapechanger. As an action you change your appearance and voice — but you can't copy someone you've never seen, and clothing/equipment doesn't change. You stay disguised until you use an action to revert or you die.

capture.Name: Memorize face under cursor
capture.Hint: Memorizes the look of the token under the mouse.

library.Name: Open face library
library.Hint: Opens the window with every known face.

revert.Name: Revert to true form
revert.Hint: Reverts your changeling to their true form.

captureMode.Name: Toggle capture mode
captureMode.Hint: While active, clicking a token memorizes its face.

UploadSource.Name: Upload destination
UploadSource.Hint: Where images uploaded by players are stored.

UploadBucket.Name: S3 bucket
UploadBucket.Hint: Only used when the destination is S3.

UploadPath.Name: Upload folder
UploadPath.Hint: Base folder; each world/character gets a subfolder.

UploadMode.Name: Upload mode
UploadMode.Hint: Automatic: users with upload permission upload directly; everyone else uploads through the connected GM. Always via GM: everything goes through the GM's browser.

MaxImageSize.Name: Max image size (px)
MaxImageSize.Hint: Larger images are downscaled and converted to WEBP before upload.

RevertOnDeath.Name: Revert on death
RevertOnDeath.Hint: On death (3 failed death saves or the Dead condition) the changeling reverts to their true form.

WhisperGM.Name: Whisper face changes to the GM
WhisperGM.Hint: Sends the GM a private message whenever a changeling changes face.

ChangeName.Name: Change the token name
ChangeName.Hint: When taking a face, the token also takes its name.

UpdatePrototype.Name: Keep the disguise on new scenes
UpdatePrototype.Hint: Also updates the prototype token so the disguise persists when the token is placed on another scene.

ChangePortrait.Name: Change the character portrait
ChangePortrait.Hint: Also changes the sheet image (restored on revert).

Transition.Name: Transformation effect
Transition.Hint: Animation used when the token art changes.

PromptName.Name: Ask for a name when memorizing
PromptName.Hint: If off, saves straight away with the token's name (or “Unknown face”).

SyncTVA.Name: Mirror into Token Variant Art
SyncTVA.Hint: If Token Variant Art is active, faces also show up as shared variants in its HUD.

GM.DesignateHint: GM: make {name} a changeling — its owner gets the face-changing tools
GM.UndesignateHint: GM: {name} is a changeling. Click to remove (the tools disappear for the player)
